messages:
alex_pm: Quick sync — launching 'Progressive Fallbacks' feature next month. Need concrete rollout plan covering feature flags, canaries, A/B tests, staged regions, and private deployment behavior. Key asks: safety windows, telemetry, customer opt-in/out, and rollback ladder.
cheng_eng: i'll draft a flag model that supports ordered fallbacks + tenant overrides. schema idea: flag contains ordered list, region overrides, canary percent, safety-windows. simple example later.
maria_sre: propose safety window policy: canary 1: 0.25% x 30m, sanity check; canary 2: 1% x 60m; ramp to 5% x 2h then region roll. automated guard: if any SLI breach (95p latency or error rate) during window -> pause and auto-revert to previous variant.
priya_data: telemetry must include per-tenant: request_latency_ms_hist, fallback_rate, quality_delta_score, tokens_per_response, and shadow_diff_samples (store N=2000 per day). also include an eval webhook for automated offline checks.
tom_pd: customer rules: enterprise tenants should be in opt-out by default; public customers opt-in. for beta customers we allow opt-in early. need clear consent flow + changelog email.
ux_ana: UX needs a console flow: set rollout scope (regions, tenants, percent), preview impacted endpoints, and toggle emergency kill-switch per region. show quick summary of quality delta and tokens saved.
legal_jane: legal note: private/on-prem customers may require offline-only fallback variants (no external hosted models). ensure contracts allow opt-out of telemetry upload. add consent checkbox in onboarding.
cheng_eng: concrete flag snippet (pseudo): ```json
{
  "name": "progressive_fallbacks_v1",
  "variants": ["primary","reduced_len","low_tok_model","local_fallback"],
  "canary_pct": 0.25,
  "stages": [{"pct":0.25,"duration_min":30},{"pct":1,"duration_min":60}],
  "region_overrides": {"eu": {"canary_pct":0.5}},
  "tenant_exceptions": ["enterprise_*"],
  "safety_windows": {"slis":["95p_latency","error_rate"],"thresholds":{"95p_latency_ms":2000,"error_rate_pct":0.5}}
}
``` keep it minimal to start.
ops_lee: ops requires an explicit rollback ladder and runbook steps: 1) hit kill-switch for region 2) set flag to previous stable variant 3) scale-up capacity if needed 4) open incident. also require CLI + console parity for toggles.
maria_sre: add regional staging order: EU -> NA -> APAC and a cool-down of 2h between full-region ramps. also require a shadow mode option so we can run 5% shadow traffic to compare quality without impacting users.
priya_data: A/B testing plan: run parallel cohorts for quality scoring, collect human evals for borderline diffs, set automatic thresholds for pass/fail. we should store sampled prompts with hashed PII.
alex_pm: decisions captured: 1) flag schema + minimal API (cheng). 2) safety windows & canary cadence (maria). 3) telemetry & AB contract (priya). 4) enterprise opt-out + legal checkbox (tom + legal). 5) console UX + kill-switch (ux_ana + ops). action: owners to post specs by Thu.
cheng_eng: note on engineering: reduced_len requires server-side prompt trimming + token accounting. will need compatibility gates for streaming responses. backlog item created.
ops_lee: FYI private deployments: we must expose a local-only variant key so customers don't get routed to hosted-only fallback. add note to deployment docs.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: applied canary policy progressive-fallbacks on prod-canary at 1717925075. monitoring hooks enabled.
alex_pm: great thread. i'll assemble the rollout playbook draft and link it here when ready. please add any missing acceptance metrics in comments. :rocket:
